profile.name: Boiron SA
profile.summary: Boiron SA manufactures and sells homeopathic medicines in France, rest of Europe, North America, and internationally. The company offers homeopathic medicines and homeopathic specialties; and other healthcare products, including medical devices (in vitro diagnostics), dietary supplements, herbal remedies, cosmetics, and CBD-based products. It also provides homeopathic specialties comprising Oscillococcinum to treat influenza symptoms, such as fever, chills, headaches, and aches; Stodal and Stodaline for treating coughs; Arnigel for adjunctive local treatment of benign trauma in the absence of open wounds; Camilia for the treatment of teething problems for babies; Sedative PC Granules to treat anxiety and emotional, and minor sleep disorders; Coryzalia for the treatment of cold symptoms and rhinitis; Homéoptic to treat eye discomfort and irritation due to various causes for adults and children; Homéovox for vocal disorders; Homéoplasmine for treating irritated skin and redness; Varésol to treat symptoms of chickenpox; and Arnicare Arthritis for use in the treatment of benign trauma pain. In addition, it offers Dermoplasmine, a plant based multi-use balm that repairs and protects irritated and damaged skin; COVID self-tests and rapid antigenic tests; LABIAMEO, that used to treat outbreaks of localized cold sores; and CONVAMEO to treat physical and mental asthenia. Further, the company provides Quietude, Rhinallergy, Ribes Nigrum Macerate Glycerin 1 DH Boiron, Sabal serrulata Mother Tincture Boiron, Sevameo, Sinupyl, Sportenine, Stodaline Sugar-Free, Stodal Granules, Stodal Syrup, Storinyl, Sedative PC Sublingual Tablet, Tilia Tomentosa Glycerinated Macerate 1DH Boiron, Varesol, Verrulia, Avenoc Suppository, Calendula Cream, Zelaceo, and Zenalia. It offers its products through distribution centers, pharmacies, pharmacy chains, wholesalers, grocery and drugstores, health food stores, and online retail. Boiron SA was founded in 1932 and is based in Messimy, France.
profile.summary_fr: Boiron SA fabrique et vend des médicaments homéopathiques en France, dans le reste de l’Europe, en Amérique du Nord et à l’international. La société propose des médicaments homéopathiques et des spécialités homéopathiques; et d'autres produits de santé, y compris des dispositifs médicaux (diagnostic in vitro), des compléments alimentaires, des remèdes à base de plantes, des cosmétiques et des produits à base de CBD. Il fournit également des spécialités homéopathiques comprenant Oscillococcinum pour traiter les symptômes de la grippe, tels que la fièvre, les frissons, les maux de tête et les douleurs; Stodal et Stodaline pour traiter la toux; Arnigel pour le traitement local adjuvant des traumatismes bénins en l'absence de plaies ouvertes; Camilia pour le traitement des problèmes de dentition pour les bébés; Granules sédatifs pour traiter l'anxiété et les troubles du sommeil.
